option_relations.rationale: Arrhythmogenic syncope due to multivessel coronary artery disease is related to Catecholaminergic Polymorphic Ventricular Tachycardia, which is a subtype of arrhythmogenic syncope
Acute myocardial ischemia-induced syncope is not directly related to the provided leaf labels
Ischemic heart disease due to obstructive coronary artery disease is a broader class containing Catecholaminergic Polymorphic Ventricular Tachycardia
Coronary Artery Disease (CAD) with Giant R-wave Syndrome is not directly related to the provided leaf labels
